sourceRepo.name: vibe-coding-os
sourceRepo.description: AI coding skill framework for disciplined vibe coding

lessons.pattern: Resolve user-provided file paths relative to the repository root, not the current working directory.
lessons.context: A validator script read config from the caller shell directory instead of the project root, causing false failures when invoked from a subdirectory.
lessons.fix: Anchor default paths to import.meta.url and only resolve user-provided paths relative to the repo root.

lessons.pattern: Do not inline shell commands in template strings without argument validation — prefer structured parameter arrays for child_process calls.
lessons.context: A build helper used string interpolation for a git command and produced a hard-to-debug failure when a branch name contained special characters.
lessons.fix: Use execFile or spawn with parameter arrays; validate and sanitize any user-derived values before they reach a shell context.

lessons.pattern: Aggregate telemetry events with an explicit reduction pass instead of mutating per-event accumulators inside a map.
lessons.context: A trend-report script used Array.map with side effects to tally pass/fail counts, making the logic fragile when new status values were added.
lessons.fix: Use a dedicated reduce pass or a status-counter helper that documents every expected value in a const enum or type union.
